title: Contracted Spend Added to the Commercial Credit Account Monthly Purchase Base
content:
For the supported limit of a Commercial Credit Account, the annual spend committed on the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement adds an amount to **the monthly purchase base**.

### Clause

Contracted spend adds to the monthly purchase base one quarter of the monthly share of the annual spend committed on an active Corbett Net-Price Contract, Corbett Cost-Plus Contract or Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement, one eighth of that monthly share on an active Corbett Category Contract or Corbett Volume Discount Agreement, and nothing otherwise.

The monthly share is the annual spend commitment recorded on the active agreement divided by twelve.

### Schedule

| Tier of the active Contract Pricing Agreement | Added to the monthly purchase base |
|---|---|
| Corbett Net-Price Contract, Corbett Cost-Plus Contract, Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement | one quarter (25 percent) of the monthly share |
| Corbett Category Contract, Corbett Volume Discount Agreement | one eighth (12.5 percent) of the monthly share |
| Corbett Account Price Schedule, or no active agreement | nothing |

### Examples (hypothetical commitments)

- An active Corbett Net-Price Contract committing 300000.00 a year: monthly share 25000.00; added 6250.00.
- An active Corbett Category Contract committing 120000.00: monthly share 10000.00; added 1250.00.
- An agreement in renewal pending or expired status is not active and adds nothing.
